title: Safety Not Found (404): Hidden Risks of LLM-Based Robotics Decision Making
findings: The paper does not have findings related to religion. The only mention is in the appendix, where a model generated an overly cautious concern about a location being 'religiously restricted and thus inaccessible to robots,' which was cited as an example of the model deviating from the original task intent during a self-refining prompt process.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. A minor mention notes an LLM considered if a site could be 'religiously restricted' as part of an overly cautious response generation process, but this was not a measured benchmark.
